items.question: What is the haṃsa when joined with earth's own and radiance joined with movement?
premises: haṃsa is joined with earth's own
items.inference: haṃsa's nature includes earth-joined radiance in motion
uncertainties: exact doctrinal referent of haṃsa unresolved
items.plain_english: The haṃsa, joined with earth's own, is radiance joined with movement.
